comments.author: Jeo
comments.body_html:
Just a heads up, this mod is currently in a “hibernation” state as I have lots of real world stuff I have to focus on and SPT is not currently one of my games of the moment. I will eventually return to this mod in the future, but for now, there’s a very simple way to keep it working for future updates:

In the mod files, there is a text document which lists the expected version of the quest loader that the mod looks for. Typically, all I need to do to “update” the mod to the latest version is change the version in these text file so that it no longer produces errors in SPT. The mod itself is unchanged, just this one line of text.

If a future update causes this mod to produce errors, simply just modifying this config file to include the up to date versions of quest loader. It SHOULD work. Anything more serious, reach out and I’ll do my best to resolve it.
